meta.price_rule: No new prices. Homia headlines from the locked towns file. El Anclote 3401 n=3 from punta-mita-gates-aug2026.json. Inside has no neighborhood headline.
meta.missing_axis_rule: If an axis still cannot be sourced, mark unknown and DROP it from the composite. Remaining weights renormalize. Do not invent. A known empty future-catalyst catalog is 0, not unknown.
hard_gates: timezone within 3h of SF / NY / Miami

peers.median_rule: Median of PV 5 de Dic, Conchas Chinas, Sayulita, Punta Mita headlines. Four values → mean of the two middle.
peers.cabo_source: MLS BCS Médano median, 27 Aug 2026 — not Homia
peers.cabo_role: off-map ceiling only — not in the median, not scored as a PVR town

formulas.spider: Each arm is 0–10. overall_0_100 = (sum score_0_10 * weight) / sum(scored weights) * 10, rounded.
formulas.hurricane_history_and_damage: Regional 5.0. Two nearby Cat-4 landfalls (Kenna 2002, Lidia 2023). Do not stamp 46 storms on a town.
formulas.safety: Municipal SESNSP 2025 total rate + State Dept 29 May 2026. BdB 6 (661/100k, Nayarit L2). PV 5 (1882/100k, Jalisco L3, PV+RN unrestricted). No town file. No gates bonus.
formulas.potable_water: PV 8.0 SEAPAL COPRISJAL 35-year NOM-127. Bucerías 5.0 named salinity/Fe/Mn. Other BdB towns UNKNOWN (no lab print).
formulas.beach_sargassum: Pacific outside NOAA SIR → sargassum 9. Blue Flag 2025–26 NV/Flamingos/La Cruz marina → 8. 5 de Dic 6 (Cuale fail is centro). Unsampled BdB swim-quality not invented.
formulas.price_runway: clip(50 + 50 * (in_radius_peer_median - headline) / in_radius_peer_median, 0, 100). Headline ≥ Cabo ceiling → 0. Spider = that score / 10.

future_catalysts.assignment: Only towns[].catalysts plus hotel-pipeline rows with town_id. 'Near San Pancho/Sayulita' and PV-wide rumors are not assigned to a scored neighborhood.

formulas.timezone_overlap: Uniform 9.0 for every town that passes the 3h gate.
